subject: Re: Redwood integration – security clarifications & exception asks
messages:
From: Morgan Patel <morgan.patel@truh.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood integration – initial security clarifications

Hi Mateo / team,

Thanks for the demo last week — TruHealth is keen to move forward but we need to close a handful of security/compliance items before legal signs off. High level asks below; I attached our filled questionnaire for detail.

Key asks
- Audit logs: customer-visible audit logs for all admin actions + per-tenant retention options. TruHealth needs "13 months" of searchable audit history for key events (credential changes, API key creation, model rollout events). Is that possible on hosted/dedicated/private deployments?
- BYOK / KMS: We host keys with our HSM vendor (Thales). We need either Redwood to support a BYOK flow with HSM-backed KEK or a scoped exception & evidence package if we must rely on Redwood-managed keys. What is the exception path?
- SSO / SAML: We require SAML2 SSO with SCIM for provisioning. Also need signed assertion and optional IdP-initiated SSO.
- Evidence: SOC2 artifact list, retention policy docs, and audit log export samples for review.

Timeline: TruHealth procurement target is to finish security review within 3 weeks to keep their Q2 rollout. Can Redwood provide a mutual action plan and indicate which items require product changes vs configuration/legal addenda?

Attachments: security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx (xlsx, ~320KB)

Thanks,
Morgan Patel
Head of Security Operations
TruHealth
phone: (415) 555-0198


From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Patel <morgan.patel@truh.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration – initial security clarifications

Thanks Morgan — appreciate the detailed questionnaire. Attaching a short compliance matrix to start (initial-compliance-matrix.pdf).

Quick, high-level answers and proposed triage:
- Audit logs: Our hosted service currently retains audit events for 90 days by default and exposes a search UI + export. For Dedicated and Private we can configure longer retention: we have customers on Dedicated/Private with 12–24 month retention using object storage exports + indexed backups. Implementing a 13-month retention for TruHealth looks feasible; we treat that as a configuration + infra task (no model/runtime change).
- BYOK / KMS: We support customer-managed keys in our Private/VPC deployments with KMS integrations; HSM-backed KEK (external HSM) requires an additional control-plane handshake and legal addendum. For Hosted we do not accept external HSM keys today — exception path requires security review, design doc, and an SLA carveout.
- SSO / SAML / SCIM: SAML2 + SCIM provisioning are supported on Dedicated/Private now; Hosted supports SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated) but SCIM is upcoming (GA roadmap Q3).
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II report is available under NDA; retention docs and an example audit export can be shared during the call/portal transfer.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Triage call w/ TruHealth security + Redwood product/infra/legal — propose Mon, 24 May at 10:00 PT.
2) We’ll produce a mutual action plan: categorize items as config/legal/product and estimate rough lead times.
3) For BYOK exception: we’ll propose a temporary exception path (legal addendum + compensating controls) while we evaluate Private HSM onboarding.

Can you confirm availability for Mon 24 and if there are any must-have evidence artifacts for the call?

Attachments: initial-compliance-matrix.pdf

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Director, Product Ops — Security & Compliance

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Patel <morgan.patel@truh.io>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration – initial security clarifications

Looping in engineering perspective on triage. Short proposal for prioritization & scope: 

Triage categories (suggested)
- Blocker: legal/procurement cannot sign without this (e.g., BYOK requirement where Hosted is unacceptable)
- High: requires non-trivial infra/product work but is deliverable in a predictable sprint cadence (e.g., retention index + export pipeline)
- Low: doc/evidence requests or config-only items (e.g., SOC2 PDF under NDA)

Initial assessment for TruHealth:
- BYOK/HSM: Blocker for Hosted. For Private, technical support exists but we need a design spike (estimated 2 sprint-equivalents) to cover KEK handshake, HSM vendor integration, and key lifecycle automation.
- Audit logs 13 months: High for Hosted (would need export + indexing + storage), Medium on Dedicated (config + storage sizing). I estimate 1 sprint for a minimal export+index pipeline if we prioritize it.
- SCIM provisioning: Can be slotted into Q3 GA for Hosted; Dedicated/Private can be fast-tracked.

Action items for product/legal/infra:
- Product: scope retention export, SCIM GA date; provide rough dev estimates.
- Infra: cost estimate for 13-month index (storage + search infra).
- Legal: draft exception/addendum template for BYOK interim path.

I attached a template we use for SLA exceptions — will save time (sla-exception-template.docx).

Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Patel <morgan.patel@truh.io>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration – initial security clarifications

Thanks — short status and commitment from Product: we can cover the retention + SSO items as follows, contingent on resource approvals below.

What we can commit to (high level)
- Audit retention (13 months): Deliverable = scheduled export job + indexer + search view. Scope includes: index schema updates, export pipelines to object storage, UI filter for "historical" view, and an importable export for legal review. Rough timeline: 6 weeks if we unblock infra/ops and prioritize in the next sprint.
- SAML + SCIM: We can deliver IdP + SP flows for SAML in 4 weeks; SCIM provisioning needs an additional sprint and QA.
- BYOK/HSM: This is larger — requires KMS design + control-plane handshake, plus legal addendum. I estimate we need a dedicated design spike (2 sprints) and at least one security review + HSM vendor QA cycle. Not doable as an interim config-only change on Hosted.

Requests / blockers
- Resource approval: need 1 infra engineer and 0.5 FE/BE each for the retention index work (cost to be approved by Ops).
- Legal: please prepare a BYOK exception addendum draft so we can present to TruHealth as an interim path.

Next steps
- Mateo: confirm Mon 24 call and include Legal (name?) + Infra lead (suggest Mina).
- Karthik: please drop your cost estimate for storage and search ops by EOD Mon so we can present ASAP.
- Morgan: if TruHealth can accept a staged approach (SAML + retention first; BYOK as multi-sprint project), will help procurement.
